notes.title: The peak of the La Festival: Solaris Day✹
notes.notes:
[p]The peak of the La Festival: [b]Solaris Day✹[/b] Tradition calls for one of the Four Sovereigns to deliver the Solaris Day speech… 🥁 And this year, the honor falls to [b]King Maeghan of Hathor[/b]. 👑[/p][p]Hey, you in the back already yawning—step forward![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45494869/0575b485123e491c4e75e585a88a61f409b2758e.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]“
Sisters of the Sun,
Today we gather once more under the blessing of our Great Mother La.
The awakening of power and the founding of Solar were no coincidence,
but destiny itself, bestowed from the heavens.[/p][p]Power is order, authority, foundation.
To purify and rule this world with the gifts of the Mother—
that is the duty of those who bear Her blessing.[/p][p]Though some deny this duty and forget their place,
even they are but trials, sent by the Great Creator.[/p][p]So today, I grant mercy and extend sisterhood.
La’s eternal light shines upon this land,
and from your prayers and joy, a flame shall rise.[/p][p]That flame shall one day light the path
to unite the world as one.[/p][p]Now, revere.
Exalt.
And—
”[/p][p][/p][p]…Apologies, Your Majesty—
we’ve run out of scroll space. 🙇‍♀️
Perhaps the [i]full[/i] speech will be revealed another time… (maybe). 🙏[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: 📢 Eclipse Streaming Guidelines
notes.notes:
[p]Team MoonSun has always allowed players to freely stream [i]Eclipse[/i].
However, as many Agents have expressed concern over broadcasting the ending—given that [i]Eclipse[/i] is heavily story-driven—we have decided to share a set of streaming requests to help minimize spoilers and preserve the game’s experience for future players.[/p][p][/p][p][b]🎥 Streaming Guidelines[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Live Streams[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]No restrictions for both the demo and full game. You may stream all the way to the ending in real time.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Climax Section[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Defined as any gameplay [b]after unlocking the “The Sun” or “The Moon” achievements[/b].
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]VODs / Clips / Edited Videos[/b]:[/p][list][*][p]Please [b]exclude the Climax Section[/b] from any VODs, clips, or edited uploads.[/p][/*][*][p]All content prior to this section may be uploaded freely.

[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]📌 [b]Summary[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Live Streaming[/b]: No restrictions (demo, full game, and ending allowed).[/p][/*][*][p][b]VODs/Clips/Edited Videos[/b]: Must exclude content after [i]The Sun[/i] or [i]The Moon[/i] achievement is unlocked.
[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to your incredible support, [i]Eclipse[/i] has successfully launched on Steam.
We hope to preserve the story experience for as many Agents as possible, and we truly appreciate your cooperation.[/p][p]For the joy and well-being of all our players—[b]Loyalty to Eclipse! 🫡[/b][/p]

notes.notes: [p]Hello, Agents.[/p][p]We have received a message from one of our Agents that our planned Steam Review Event could potentially violate Steam’s policies. [h2][b]⚜️Note⚜️[/b][/h2]
Several members have given us valuable feedback! We highly value our players' opinions and strive to reflect the world of our work as faithfully as possible. We sincerely appreciate your interest and support💛

Originally, we considered changing "雄偉" to "雌偉" to align with the concept of a world where only women exist. However, we recognized that this term is not commonly used in Chinese, which was an important factor to consider. Since our understanding of Chinese is not extensive, we carefully deliberated on the best way to convey the intended meaning, utilizing translation tools to ensure accuracy.

As a result, we determined that modifying the term to a gender-neutral expression would help more players intuitively understand the context while maintaining linguistic naturalness.

Although our grasp of the Chinese language may not be perfect, we have done our best to balance the coherence of our world with appropriate wording. We will continue striving to create a more immersive and natural gaming experience.

Once again, thank you for your valuable feedback!
